reports.vruDetails: Substantial water-filled pothole conceals depth (>50mm estimated) with sharp vertical asphalt edges. High probability of front-tire capture, rim damage, and sudden over-the-handlebar ejection for two-wheelers and vulnerable road users.

triagePayload.vruDetails: Substantial water-filled pothole conceals depth (>50mm estimated) with sharp vertical asphalt edges. High probability of front-tire capture, rim damage, and sudden over-the-handlebar ejection for two-wheelers and vulnerable road users.

reports.vruDetails: Standing water conceals true cavity depth. Sharp fractured vertical asphalt lips create severe tire-snagging hazard, high risk of front-wheel deflection and rider ejection for motorcycles and bicycles.
reports.recommendedAction: Drain standing water, mark and saw-cut distress boundaries at least 150mm into sound surrounding pavement, excavate compromised base material, apply bituminous tack coat to base and vertical edges, fill with compacted hot-mix asphalt (HMA) in lifts not exceeding 50mm, and finish with vibratory plate compaction.
materialsChecklist: Hot-mix asphalt (HMA) or high-performance polymer-modified cold patch
Asphalt diamond-blade saw or pavement breaker
Sub-base aggregate (if uncompacted base is exposed)
Traffic safety cones and high-visibility signage

reports.vruDetails: Severe longitudinal tire-trap channel and loose, fragmented asphalt blocks. Two-wheeler front tires are prone to severe rut-lock, lateral displacement, and immediate rim deflection, posing extreme ejection and fatal spill risk in high-density motorcycle/tricycle traffic.
reports.recommendedAction: Emergency full-depth reclamation and patch: Saw-cut damaged perimeter beyond the fatigue boundary, excavate degraded wearing and base course, stabilize and compact granular sub-base, apply asphalt emulsion tack coat, and lay multi-lift hot-mix asphalt (HMA) with vibratory roller compaction.
materialsChecklist: Vibratory plate compactor / tandem road roller
Traffic safety cones and high-visibility warning signage
